title: Two lenses
goalLine: Tilt the dial so both meters read at least 84% sure.

hints.text: Balance the arrow halfway between up and sideways.
An angle of 45 degrees gives the best compromise between the two meters.

events.trade-off: Making one meter certain drops the other to a coin flip.

removePhysicsNote: Unlike classical objects, a parcel cannot be simultaneously certain in both lenses.
